info.title: BotNexus.Cli
info.description: BotNexus platform CLI — install and run the BotNexus AI agent platform. Requires .NET 10 SDK.

options.name: --target
options.description: BotNexus home directory (config, workspace, extensions). Defaults to ~/.botnexus or BOTNEXUS_HOME.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate BotNexus platform configuration.

options.name: --remote
options.description: Validate using the running gateway /api/config/validate endpoint.

options.name: --gateway-url
options.description: Gateway base URL override for remote validation.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Initialize ~/.botnexus with a default config and required directories.

commands.name: agent
commands.description: Manage configured agents.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List configured agents.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add an agent to config.json.

options.name: --display-name
options.description: Human-readable display name (defaults to agent ID if not set).

options.name: --emoji
options.description: Emoji shown alongside the agent name in clients (e.g. "🤖").

options.name: --disabled
options.description: Disable the agent (sets Enabled = false). Takes precedence over --enabled.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove an agent from config.json.

commands.name: wizard
commands.description: Interactively create a new agent using a step-by-step wizard.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show the resolved configuration for a single agent.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit raw JSON instead of a formatted table.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export an agent as a redacted agentTemplate/v1 JSON template (safe to share; contains no secrets).

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path (defaults to <id>.agent.json in the current directory).

commands.name: import
commands.description: Import an agent from a redacted agentTemplate/v1 JSON template, with optional --set overrides.

options.name: --id
options.description: Target agent ID (defaults to the --set id override, then the template file name).

options.name: --set
options.description: Override a descriptor field before materializing (key=value). Repeatable. Keys: id, displayName, description, emoji, model, provider, thinking, contextWindow.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace an existing agent with the same ID. Without this flag an ID collision is refused.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to an agentTemplate/v1 JSON file to import.

commands.name: memory
commands.description: Memory store operations.

commands.name: backfill
commands.description: Index conversation turns from existing sessions into memory stores.

options.name: --agent
options.description: Backfill only this agent. If omitted, backfill all agents.

commands.name: config
commands.description: Read and update BotNexus configuration.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Get a config value by dotted key.

commands.name: set
commands.description: Set a config value by dotted key.

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Generate JSON schema for platform config.

commands.name: locations
commands.description: Manage configured locations.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all registered locations.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a location to config.json.

options.name: --type
options.description: Location type: filesystem, api, mcp-server, database, remote-node.

options.name: --path
options.description: Filesystem path or primary location path.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update an existing location.

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a location from config.json.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Run CLI diagnostics.

commands.name: locations
commands.description: Check location accessibility.

commands.name: config
commands.description: Guided config migration — detect and apply missing settings.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Apply all applicable fixes without prompting.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report what would change but do not write anything.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Clone the BotNexus repository and optionally build it.

options.name: --source
options.description: Directory to clone into. Defaults to ~/botnexus.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Build the BotNexus solution.

options.name: --path
options.description: Path to the repository root. Defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --dev
options.description: Build from a development repo clone instead of the install location.

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Start a BotNexus service in the foreground (development mode). Defaults to the gateway. Note: for production/background use, prefer 'gateway start' which runs the gateway as a detached process.

options.name: --source
options.description: Path to the BotNexus repository root. Defaults to ~/botnexus.

commands.name: gateway
commands.description: Manage the BotNexus Gateway lifecycle (start detached, stop, status, restart). For foreground/dev mode use 'serve' or 'serve gateway'

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start the gateway process

options.name: --source
options.description: Path to the BotNexus repository root. Defaults to ~/botnexus.

options.name: --attached
options.description: Run in foreground instead of detached mode.

options.name: --skip-build
options.description: Skip the implicit solution rebuild before starting. Use this when you've already built (e.g. CI, tests, or `dotnet build` ran moments ago) — otherwise the rebuild step will fight for file locks if any binary is in use.

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop the gateway process

commands.name: status
commands.description: Check gateway process status

commands.name: restart
commands.description: Restart the gateway process

options.name: --source
options.description: Path to the BotNexus repository root. Defaults to ~/botnexus.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Install the gateway as an OS service (systemd/Windows Service/launchd)

options.name: --source
options.description: Path to the BotNexus repository root. Defaults to ~/botnexus.

commands.name: uninstall
commands.description: Stop and remove the gateway OS service

commands.name: probe
commands.description: Start the BotNexus Probe diagnostic tool.

options.name: --port
options.description: Port for the Probe web UI.

options.name: --source
options.description: Path to the BotNexus repository root. Defaults to ~/botnexus.

options.name: --gateway-url
options.description: URL of a running BotNexus Gateway.

commands.name: prompt
commands.description: Manage prompt templates.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List prompt templates.

options.name: --target
options.description: BotNexus home directory (config, workspace, extensions). Defaults to ~/.botnexus or BOTNEXUS_HOME.

commands.name: render
commands.description: Render a prompt template.

options.name: --param
options.description: Template parameter as key=value. Repeat for multiple values.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Render and run a prompt template.

options.name: --param
options.description: Template parameter as key=value. Repeat for multiple values.

options.name: --session
options.description: Optional session ID when invoking the gateway.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create prompt templates.

commands.name: samples
commands.description: Initialize sample prompt templates in ~/.botnexus/prompts

options.name: --target
options.description: BotNexus home directory (config, workspace, extensions). Defaults to ~/.botnexus or BOTNEXUS_HOME.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Pull latest source, build, and restart the BotNexus gateway.

options.name: --source
options.description: Path to the BotNexus repository root. Defaults to ~/botnexus.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Check whether updates are available from origin/main.

options.name: --source
options.description: Path to the BotNexus repository root. Defaults to ~/botnexus.

commands.name: provider
commands.description: Configure and authenticate LLM providers.

options.name: --provider
options.description: Pre-select the provider to configure (github-copilot | openai | anthropic | ollama). Skips the interactive provider-selection prompt.

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Interactively add and authenticate a new provider.

options.name: --provider
options.description: Pre-select the provider to configure (github-copilot | openai | anthropic | ollama). Skips the interactive provider-selection prompt and runs the rest of the setup flow (API-key prompt or OAuth device-code flow). Useful for scripting and integration tests.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List configured providers.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add or update a provider non-interactively. Useful for scripts and CI.

options.name: --api
options.description: API contract handled by this provider (e.g. 'openai-completions', 'openai-responses', 'anthropic-messages', 'integration-mock'). Defaults to 'openai-completions'.

options.name: --api-key
options.description: API key value, or 'auth:<name>' to reference an auth.json OAuth entry.

options.name: --base-url
options.description: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, or catalog path for 'integration-mock'.

options.name: --default-model
options.description: Default model id for this provider.

options.name: --model
options.description: Allowed model id (repeatable). Omit to allow all models registered for this provider.

options.name: --disabled
options.description: Mark the provider as disabled. Disabled providers are hidden from the API.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove a provider non-interactively.

commands.name: copilot
commands.description: GitHub Copilot diagnostics and auth helpers.

commands.name: login
commands.description: Authenticate to GitHub Copilot via device code flow (alias for `provider setup --provider github-copilot`).

commands.name: whoami
commands.description: Show the authenticated Copilot user, plan, endpoint, and token expiry.

commands.name: models
commands.description: List the GitHub Copilot models the authenticated user is entitled to invoke.

commands.name: quota
commands.description: Show the current Copilot quota snapshots (chat, completions, premium interactions).

commands.name: test
commands.description: Round-trip a single request through the carved-out Copilot provider to confirm end-to-end connectivity.

options.name: --model
options.description: Copilot model id to round-trip (default: gpt-5-mini).

commands.name: ollama
commands.description: Ollama local model diagnostics and helpers.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Check Ollama server connectivity and version.

commands.name: models
commands.description: List models available on the local Ollama instance.

commands.name: test
commands.description: Round-trip a single request through Ollama to confirm end-to-end connectivity.

options.name: --model
options.description: Model to test (default: first available model).

commands.name: cron
commands.description: Manage cron jobs on a running BotNexus gateway.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all cron jobs.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Show details for a single cron job.

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a cron job.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Trigger a cron job immediately.

commands.name: enable
commands.description: Enable a cron job.

commands.name: disable
commands.description: Disable a cron job.

commands.name: satellite
commands.description: Manage satellite nodes.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all registered satellites.

commands.name: register
commands.description: Register a new satellite and generate its API key.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove a satellite from config.

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Platform diagnostics - inspect sessions, logs, databases, and live gateway state.

commands.name: cron
commands.description: Inspect cron scheduler state directly (offline, no gateway required).

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show scheduler health: enabled jobs, last/next tick.

commands.name: history
commands.description: Show recent run outcomes from cron.sqlite.

commands.name: missed
commands.description: Identify jobs that should have fired but did not.

commands.name: db
commands.description: Raw database introspection (offline, no gateway required).

commands.name: tables
commands.description: List tables with row counts across all registered databases.

options.name: --db
options.description: Filter to a single database by name (e.g. sessions, cron, webhooks, skill-usage).

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Show CREATE TABLE statements across all registered databases.

options.name: --db
options.description: Filter to a single database by name (e.g. sessions, cron, webhooks, skill-usage).

commands.name: size
commands.description: Show file sizes for all registered database files.

commands.name: gateway
commands.description: Inspect live gateway state via REST API (requires running gateway).

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show gateway uptime, version, and session count.

commands.name: sessions
commands.description: List active sessions from the gateway.

commands.name: providers
commands.description: List registered providers and model counts.

commands.name: config
commands.description: Dump resolved gateway configuration (secrets redacted).

options.name: --section
options.description: Filter to a specific config section.

commands.name: logs
commands.description: Inspect log files directly (offline, no gateway required).

commands.name: tail
commands.description: Show most recent log lines.

options.name: --level
options.description: Filter by log level: debug, info, warn, error.

commands.name: errors
commands.description: Show recent error log lines (shorthand for tail --level error).

commands.name: search
commands.description: Search across log files for a keyword.

options.name: --since
options.description: Only search log files after this datetime (ISO format).

commands.name: session
commands.description: Find all log lines mentioning a session ID.

arguments.name: SESSION_ID
arguments.description: Session ID to search for in logs.

commands.name: memory
commands.description: Inspect agent memory directories (offline, no gateway required).

options.name: --agent
options.description: Show detailed view for a single agent.

commands.name: sessions
commands.description: Inspect session store directly (offline, no gateway required).

commands.name: list
commands.description: List sessions from sessions.db.

options.name: --status
options.description: Filter by status: active, sealed, expired, all.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Show full session metadata.

commands.name: compaction
commands.description: Show compaction summary for a session.

commands.name: stats
commands.description: Show aggregate session statistics.

commands.name: conversation
commands.description: Manage conversations via the gateway REST API.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List active conversations.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Show conversation metadata, participants, and bindings.

commands.name: archive
commands.description: Archive a conversation.

commands.name: subagent
commands.description: Inspect and maintain sub-agent runtime artifacts.

commands.name: workspace
commands.description: List and prune stale sub-agent workspace directories.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List sub-agent workspace directories and whether each is prunable.

commands.name: prune
commands.description: Delete workspace directories for terminal (completed/failed/timed-out) sub-agents.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: List what would be pruned without deleting anything.
